read-input.subject: A bronze funnel with three small foe-shaped shadows above it and three faceted crystals falling out of the bottom.

monte-carlo.subject: A bronze roulette wheel with crystal pockets, one pocket glowing, a small ivory ball resting in it.

reservoir-sampling.subject: A small bronze water tank with three faceted crystals floating inside and a stream of crystals flowing past outside.

swap-ends.subject: Two faceted crystals exchanging places along two curved bronze arrows that form a circle.

rotate-bolts.subject: A bronze wheel with faceted crystals around its rim and one bronze arrow showing a quarter turn.

enumerate-bolts.subject: A row of faceted crystals on a bronze rail, each with a growing row of small gold notches under it (notches only, no numerals).

slice-bolts.subject: A bronze knife cutting a row of faceted crystals after the fourth one, the cut end glowing.

pop-bolt.subject: A faceted crystal popping out of the end of a bronze tube like a cork, its glow streaming to the far end.

bit-shift.subject: A row of small square crystal bits sliding one step left on a bronze track, the leftmost bit falling off the edge.

sort-by-key.subject: Crystals of three colours being sorted into three neat bronze trays by colour, smallest to largest in each.

range-source.subject: Four faceted crystals of evenly growing size standing on four evenly spaced bronze steps.

list-comprehension.subject: A bronze bracket frame with crystals passing through a small gate inside it, the weak ones turned away (no letters).
